tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to create an account using my university .edu email, so that only members of the university can use the marketplace.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The system requires a .edu email address when creating an account.
- The system verifies the email address before activating the account.
- A user without a valid .edu email cannot create an active account.

tickets.title: Scan item barcode
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to scan an item's barcode with my phone camera, so that I can quickly enter the item's ISBN and title when creating a listing.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The student can open the barcode scanner when creating a listing.
- The system can scan the item's barcode using the phone camera.
- The system fills in the ISBN and title from the scanned barcode when the information is available.
- The student can review the scanned information before creating the listing.

tickets.title: Create auction listing
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to create an auction for an item, so that I can sell my item through competitive bidding.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The student can choose auction as the listing type.
- The student can enter the item information and starting price.
- The system creates the listing as an auction.
- Other students can see that the listing is an auction.

tickets.title: Select Safe Exchange Zone
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to select a Safe Exchange Zone before starting a chat with another user, so that physical meetups can take place in a safer location.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The system displays available Safe Exchange Zones.
- The student must select a Safe Exchange Zone before starting a chat for a physical meetup.
- The system prevents the student from starting the chat if no Safe Exchange Zone is selected.
- The selected Safe Exchange Zone is shown to the users involved in the meetup.

tickets.title: Manage marketplace listings
tickets.description:
As an Administrator/Staff, I want to manage marketplace listings that violate university marketplace rules, so that the marketplace remains safe and appropriate for students.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Authorized staff can view marketplace listings that have been reported.
- Authorized staff can remove a listing that violates marketplace rules.
- The system records that the listing was removed.
- Students can no longer view a removed listing.

tickets.description: Usability: Students should be able to scan an item's barcode with their phone camera to enter product information instead of manually typing the ISBN and title.

analysis.ambiguity1: The requirement that only users with a valid .edu email address can create an account is vague because it does not specify how the system will verify that the email address is valid and belongs to the university.
analysis.ambiguity2: The requirement to suggest Safe Exchange Zones and force users to select one before chatting is vague because it does not specify how the system should choose or recommend a safe zone for a particular meetup.
analysis.conflictSolution: The Student Union President wants the app to collect a 2% transaction fee, while the University Legal Team says the university cannot handle any money and the app cannot process payments. The app should not process or hold student payments. The 2% fee should only be considered if the university approves a separate compliant payment arrangement; otherwise, the transaction fee should be removed from the marketplace.
analysis.nfr1: Security: Only users with a valid verified .edu email address should be allowed to create an account.
analysis.nfr2: Safety: The system should require users to select a Safe Exchange Zone before they can start a chat for a physical meetup.
analysis.nfr3: Usability: Students should be able to scan an item's barcode with their phone camera to enter product information instead of manually typing the ISBN and title.
